details.completeness_justification: The candidate summary adequately covers the core material meaning of K1-K5 and K7, including revenue/profit figures, margin changes, apartment delivery trends, sales agreements, and bond issuance. However, it omits critical details for K6 (portfolio expansion specifics), K8 (Toronto project approval), K9 (2026 project launches), and K10 (2026 loan agreement), all of which are HIGH-importance items requiring explicit coverage. While the summary is strong on financial performance and some operational metrics, these missing elements represent substantial gaps in the overall picture.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements are logically connected and support each other without contradictions. The summary follows a clear structure: starting with overall financial performance (revenue, profit), then detailing drivers of change (volume decrease, margin compression), followed by operational metrics (development pipeline, pre-sales), and concluding with balance sheet changes. There are no self-contradictions, logical gaps, or organizational problems. While there is a natural progression from income statement to balance sheet items, all transitions are smooth and justified within the text. The summary avoids unnecessary repetition and maintains consistent terminology throughout.
